quests.title: Wangshu Take-Away

dialogue.sit: I've got something else to do.

dialogue.t: I really can't spare the time right now...

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogue.t: Agh, I don't think I can get back in time.

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: So it's like this: that air-headed Ling'guan ordered some Come And Get It, saying that she'd come back and eat it later. But my money's on her having wandered off somewhere and gotten lost.
Go deliver this to her. Steady now, and don't run around however you like, or it'll spill.
Try to avoid touching elemental stuff as well, or the taste might get all mixed up.
If it goes bad, come back here and I'll whip up another serving for you.
Oh, you actually brought it all the way here. Thank you so much!

quests.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
